changes.text: 张之洞一生久任地方大员，传文称他「任疆寄數十年」；在这份议奏之前，他已在广东办过学堂、枪炮厂和矿务局。他的铁路议奏写于一场争执之中：朝中就修不修铁路、修在哪里有几种主张。《清史稿·张之洞传》记：「會海軍衙門奏請修京通鐵路，臺諫爭陳鐵路之害，請停辦」。海军衙门（从名称看，是主管海军事务的衙署）主张修京通铁路；台谏（负责进言、弹劾的言官）争陈铁路之害，请停办。传文接着记了另外两种主张：「翁同龢等請試修邊地，便用兵；徐會灃請改修德州濟寧路，利漕運」。翁同龢等主张试修边地，理由是便于用兵；徐会沣主张改修德州济宁路，理由是利于漕运。传文在这几种主张之后，才录下张之洞就此所上的议奏。至于台谏所说的害具体是哪几条、海军衙门的理由为何，传文都没有记。

Zhang Zhidong spent much of his career as a senior provincial official; the biography says he held provincial posts for several decades. Before this memorial, he had already set up an academy, an arsenal, and a mining bureau in Guangdong. His railway memorial was written in the middle of a dispute: at court there were several positions on whether to build railways and where. His biography in the Draft History of the Qing records it this way (here and throughout, quotations from the Chinese are our own translations): "When the Naval Office petitioned to build the Beijing-Tongzhou railway, the censors pressed the harms of railways and asked that the project be halted." The Naval Office, which, as its name indicates, was the office in charge of naval affairs, stood for building the Beijing-Tongzhou line. The censors, the court's officials charged with remonstrance and impeachment, pressed the harms and asked for a stop. The biography then records two further proposals. Weng Tonghe and others asked to try building in the frontier regions, for ease of moving troops. Xu Huifeng asked to build a Dezhou-Jining line instead, for the benefit of grain transport. Only after these positions does the biography record the memorial Zhang Zhidong submitted on the matter. Which harms the censors meant, and what reasons the Naval Office gave, the biography does not record.

dispositions.rationale: 在段首交代了张之洞的身份。依据有两处：一是证据所载「任疆寄數十年」，据此说他久任地方大员；二是他此前在广东办学堂、枪炮厂、矿务局。“晚清”一词证据包中没有，所以没有采用。“海军衙门”首次出现处补了括注，并注明“从名称看”，表明这是据名称作的说明，没有引入证据外的职掌细节。段末“本文传主张之洞”改为“张之洞就此所上的议奏”，点明他与这场争议的关系。英文同步修改，ev 补入 E21、E1。其余事实与限定未动。
